citation: Javed et al., Svarah: Evaluating English ASR Systems on Indian Accents, 2023.
purpose_in_project: Document Indian-accented English evaluation. Do not claim the Web Speech API was trained on Svarah.
recommended_eval_protocol: Download Svarah from the official AI4Bharat release.
Play or speak utterances similar to the transcripts in evaluation_phrases.json.
Capture Web Speech API hypotheses in Chrome/Edge with lang=en-IN.
Compute WER/CER offline if you have reference transcripts. This repo does not ship pre-computed WER.
